recommendation: Keep the source correction. Any cleanup of generated diagrams or older negative fixture wording should be handled separately as artifact maintenance, not as a further FHIR-52900 conformance change.
issue_request: FHIR-52900 was an Applied/Persuasive Imaging Integration change request to replace the ambiguous ImagingSelection.instance.subset string with mutually exclusive explicit elements for frames, referenced content items, segments, regions of interest, and waveform channels.
initial_application: The main application landed in commits 5de7a3af1c, 2019452736, and e7fdf3889d, which split the subset element, fixed mutual-exclusion constraints, and added invariant failure tests. Current source already contained the split elements and examples, but waveFormChannel retained a copied requirement saying it corresponded to a waveform structure set SOP Class.
additional_context: The linked Confluence draft and current notes both describe waveFormChannel as selected from a waveform SOP Instance/SOP Class. ImagingSelection is active in source/fhir.ini. Other subset references found during review were the R5-to-R6 change-log entry, generated-looking SVG text, or negative invariant test-fixture content and did not change the conformance rule.
reconciliation: Updated source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml so ImagingSelection.instance.waveFormChannel is only allowed when instance.sopClass corresponds to a waveform SOP Class, removing the erroneous structure-set wording.
source_changes: source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml: corrected ImagingSelection.instance.waveFormChannel requirements from "waveform  structure set SOP Class" to "waveform SOP Class".

related_jiras.note: FHIR-52900's resolution noted that example updates also addressed Imaging Selection QA issues; this run did not decide the separate QA issue.
Example-update commits mentioned it with FHIR-52900, but it concerns separate ImagingStudy/ImagingSelection bodySite and laterality work.
